title: Zombies at the movies?
content: I used to think i didnt visit mallworld in my dreams, but, the airport post the other day reminded me of a few dreams that i now actually think WERE mallworld. The long escalators leading to hybrid airport/somethingelseport (sometimes ships sometimes trains etc) underground parking which goes like... way too deep. In my dreams theres 70+ sublevels to drive through. The tunnels are immense. I mention the tunnels for the next part. I keep having dreams about escaping into those tunnels, from a hybrid movietheatre / school. Its graduation day, late, and people are showing up. Ive had this dream so many times, 5+, that when i recognize it, i immediately start looking for a way to escape. Its usually dark, around 7pm. The graduation starts at 8pm ish. It lasts a few hours. But 2 hours in, someone falls sick, and no one really makes a fuss of it. Then it tears through the crowd, lots of coughing etc. Then they start rising as zombies. After living this dream so many times, ive managed to explore some of the events around this. For some reason, it starts in the parking lot? If i escape before 8pm, im fine. But around 7:30, while the show is starting, someone succumbs outside. This brings Emergency services. But the military also shows up sometimes? by the time the show has started, its too late to escape, its already spreading outside but not yet inside. Thats why i run off to the tunnels.
